name: plasma-demo
description: Modern Zig WebAssembly Plasma Software Renderer Demo

scripts.build: echo '🚀 Compiling Zig to WebAssembly (ReleaseSmall)...' && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseSmall
scripts.build:debug: echo '🚀 Compiling Zig to WebAssembly (Debug)...' && zig build
scripts.build:dist: npm run build && echo '📦 Initiating full asset compression pipeline...' && node scripts/build_dist.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && echo '🌐 Starting local dev server...' && npx serve web -l 9000
